Leila (AM): Opening Deltacorp POC. Needs SAML SSO, SCIM bulk ~450k users, RBAC group->role mapping, domain proof, and an air-gapped on-prem option. Need blockers + pricing bands by Wed.
Omar (SE): SCIM plan: initial bulk + 1h delta syncs. Recommend chunks 2k-5k, concurrency 8-12. Will they accept eventual consistency for group changes?
Pri (Eng): We support eventual + near-real-time via webhooks but webhooks at this scale need backpressure. Example bulk POST: ```curl -X POST https://scim.redwood.company/v2/Bulk -d @b.json -H 'Content-Type: application/json'```
Ravi (Infra): Air-gapped requires network diagram, RTO/RPO, and signed SOW for zero management-plane access. Support uplift ~15% and one-time deployment fee.
Leila (AM): They estimate ~220 TPS auth checks peak. Thoughts on Dedicated vs Hosted?
Omar (SE): 220 TPS -> recommend Dedicated reserved nodes for steady latency. I'll draft pricing: Dedicated baseline + Hosted overflow + air-gap uplift.
ops-bot: ops-bot: provisioning task deltacorp-onprem queued -> awaiting IP allowlist (owner: infra)
Leila (AM): Action items: (1) Leila get network diagram + SAML metadata + QPS cert; (2) Pri write SCIM runbook + backoff params; (3) Omar produce pricing bands + uplift; (4) Ravi prepare KMS/HSM checklist for Legal. Sync Tue EOD. :thumbsup:
